decision.rationale: This dispute was opened too early, so it is declined. TXN-007977 (16186 minor units, LARKSPUR APPAREL, MER-000015, card CRD-000245) posted on 2026-10-08. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 16 days later, which is inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000035 gives 2026-10-21 as the expected delivery date. The dispute was opened only 3 days after that date. Under goods-not-received-wait, a cardholder must wait 15 days after the expected delivery date before opening a dispute, and a dispute opened earlier is declined. The cardholder may open a new dispute from 2026-11-05 if the order still has not arrived. The case documents contain no instructions to the bank.

proposed_actions.reason: Your dispute was opened 3 days after the expected delivery date of 2026-10-21. We need to allow 15 days after that date in case a late delivery still arrives. If the order has still not arrived, you can open a new dispute from 2026-11-05.
